[ASSISTANT_SAID] 8. **The Dresden Files** by Jim Butcher: A wizard detective in modern-day Chicago investigating supernatural crimes.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 9. **The Rivers of London** series by Ben Aaronovitch: A detective in London investigating supernatural crimes.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 10. **The October Daye** series by Seanan McGuire: A half-fae private investigator in modern-day San Francisco navigating faerie politics.
